command:
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
git fetch origin main --no-tags --prune
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "fetch main failed" }
if ((git rev-parse origin/main).Trim() -ne "5eb0fbb50c627a736e8e6ca2bb4d9793ebad33ea") { throw "main moved" }
$source = "C:\dev\flyExplorer\logs\m23"
$target = "C:\dev\flyExplorer\logs\remote-evidence"
$files = @(
  "large-resident-window-before.png",
  "large-resident-window-after.png",
  "large-browse-over-20k-after.png"
)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $target | Out-Null
Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $target -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force
foreach($name in $files){
  $src = Join-Path $source $name
  if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $src -PathType Leaf)) { throw "required image missing: $name" }
  Copy-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination (Join-Path $target $name)
}
Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath ($files | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $source $_ }) |
  ForEach-Object { "$($_.Path) $($_.Hash)" } |
  Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 -LiteralPath (Join-Path $target "large-folder-20k-sha256.txt")
Write-Host "LARGE_FOLDER_20K_EVIDENCE_EXPORT_PASS"
